BETA Close X The Sage Group PLC has announced the purchase of 1,381,258 of its ordinary shares on the London Stock Exchange and multilateral trading facilities. The purchases occurred on May 7, 2026, with the highest price paid per share being 898.0000 pence and the lowest at 875.6000 pence, resulting in a volume-weighted average price of 886.3167 pence per share. These transactions are part of a share buyback program initiated on March 2, 2026, which is scheduled to conclude by June 5, 2026, and all acquired shares will be cancelled. Disclaimer* Sage Group PLC (The) 07 May 2026 THE SAGE GROUP PLC TRANSACTION IN OWN SHARES The Sage Group plc ("Sage" or the "Group") announces today that it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 1 4 / 77 pence each on the London Stock Exchange and Multilateral Trading Facilities from J.P. Morgan Securities plc (''JPMS''). This is pursuant to the share buyback programme announced on 2 March 2026 which is expected to end no later than 5 June 2026.
